answer: Use introduction-by-bond: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it by locking 500 POA as a sponsor bond. First, sponsor and stake are recorded on-ledger. Second, the newcomer gets limited rights for 30 days under scoring. Third, if it spams or clones identities, the sponsor loses the full 500 POA and its reputation drops. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 sponsors risking 500,000 POA, like a terrace garden where each new plant needs a gardener staking its harvest — the nectar of free identities turns bitter, and the system reads like a sonnet: strict form, no forgery.
